items.description: Laptop damage payment - cracked screen and lower-right corner impact damage
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2 (thrown against fixed interior part of conveyance during evasive manoeuvre); both damage areas are one loss on one unit (2.6.3). Repair cost of screen plus corner housing approx. EUR 1,150-1,400, capped under 7.1.10 at the acquisition price of an equivalent new unit, EUR 1,400; no deductible or sub-limit stated.
